text:
maya: quick heads-up - on q4_1 bring-up I hit a deterministic detok/joining problem for mixed CJK+latin numeric lines when kvcache chunking is on. small devset shows BLEU down ~2.6 vs float baseline.
tao: can you paste a tiny repro? sounds like ZWJ or token merge.
maya: input: "\u5357\u4eac\u5e02 2023 Annual Report (Summary)"
maya: baseline detok: \u5357\u4eac\u5e02 2023 Annual Report (Summary)
maya: q4_1+kvcache detok: \u5357\u4eac\u5e02 2023 Annual Report ( Summary )  <-- extra spaces and bracket orientation oddness for RTL pairs later
 elena: very similar to the spacing-on-number issue we saw before but also a ZWJ drop in some kana>hangul mixes. token ids?
maya: baseline ids slice: [1305, 7702, 90033, 45, 99]  // 90033 covers '2023' + following char
maya: q4_1+kvcache ids:    [1305, 7702, 900, 33, 45, 99]   // split 900 + 33 -> causes space
tao: does it reproduce with kvcache disabled or batch_size=1?
maya: only when batch_size>1 AND kvcache.chunksize >= 32. single-example path matches baseline.
devops-bot: canary runtime note: q4_1 on p4d nodes uses kernel-set "kv-fast-3" as of build 2025-02-11.
 elena: did tokenizer or tokenizers lib change in the bundle? That could make borderline merges different.
maya: tokenizers pinned same, but we did refactor batching normalization (PR #4217) to run after batch-concat. suspected culprit.
tao: bisect plan: A) baseline weights + new preproc; B) new q4_1 weights + old preproc; C) q4_1 runtime but revert kernel to kv-fast-2. Run small matrix.
maya: kicking off A and C on canary.
eval-bot: running mixed-cjk-numeric suite (n=900) q4_1+kvcache vs baseline float
eval-bot: overall BLEU delta = -2.6; numeric+paren subgroup delta = -5.3; ja/ko mixed chrF delta = -3.9
 elena: those deltas point to token boundary jitter causing detok differences and downstream generation shift. any RTL examples?
maya: yes: en->ar sample where parentheses flipped: "\u0627\u062e\u0628\u0627\u0631 (2023)" -> "\u0627\u062e\u0628\u0627\u0631 )2023(" when kvcache chunking active. looks like bidi reordering interacting with token offsets.
tao: if normalize-after-batch is the issue, revert to per-example normalization and re-run. we should also add a unit test for CJK+digits+ZWJ with batching.
maya: applied a per-example normalization revert on canary tag q4_1-rc2 and re-ran the 900-sample suite.
eval-bot: rerun complete: BLEU delta now -0.2; numeric subgroup delta = -0.4; RTL bracket flips gone.
 elena: good. please add regression test and CI gate on the refactor. I'll file a follow-up to update onboarding notes mentioning kvcache+batching caveats.
maya: repro script (local):
```
# repro tokenize batch vs per-example
python - <<'PY'
from model_preproc import tokenize_batch
s = '\u5357\u4eac\u5e02 2023 Annual Report (Summary)'
print('batched:', tokenize_batch([s,s], normalize_after_batch=True))
print('per-example:', tokenize_batch([s,s], normalize_after_batch=False))
PY
```
 tao: tagging @infra for kernel audit and @devexp for docs. hold q4_1 rollout until canary stable across ja/ko/zh and RTL suites. :white_check_mark:
